query:
SELECT twitch_login AS "twitch_login!",
                   twitch_user_id AS "twitch_user_id!",
                   COALESCE(raid_bot_enabled, 0) AS "raid_bot_enabled!"
            FROM twitch_streamers_partner_state
            WHERE LOWER(twitch_login) = $1
              AND is_partner_active = 1
            LIMIT 1
